set.title: Denial-management suite for outsourced medical billing companies (Tebra first)

fixture.label: queue #11 benchmark case F3: a real opportunity from queue #10 (the billing-company runner-up) with a proposal written for the benchmark; the appetite and the proposal are test fixtures

proposed_solution.summary: A denial-management suite for billing companies: one queue across all clients, appeal drafting, a Tebra API sync, automatic portal submission, root-cause analytics and a client portal.

features.name: Cross-client denial queue
features.does: Sort the posted 835 remittances of every client, from every PM system's export format, by denial reason (CARC/RARC), filing deadline and dollars

features.name: Appeal drafting
features.does: Draft payer-specific appeal letters for every denial reason, for staff review

features.name: Tebra API sync
features.does: Pull remittances and claim data from Tebra automatically through the Tebra API and write appeal status back

features.name: Automatic portal submission
features.does: Submit approved appeals to payer portals automatically with browser automation

features.name: Root-cause analytics
features.does: Dashboards of denial trends by client, payer and reason, with monthly PDF reports

features.name: Client portal
features.does: A portal where each client practice sees its denials and appeal status
